title: single_item_producer_consumer
summary: Single-item producer-consumer handoff using a mutex and condition variable, with producer marking ready and waking consumer, consumer computing checksum, ensuring no deadlock/lost wakeup and eventual consumption.

domain_types.name: Checksum
domain_types.description: Simple checksum computation over the consumed integer item

clauses.text: There must be no lost wakeup: if the producer marks the slot ready and signals, the consumer must not miss the notification.
Any produced item is eventually consumed.
Both producer and consumer threads eventually exit (complete).
The consumer computes a simple checksum over the consumed integer item.

requirements.text: There must be no lost wakeup: if the producer marks the slot ready and signals, the consumer must not miss the notification.
Any produced item is eventually consumed.
Both producer and consumer threads eventually exit (complete).
The consumer computes a simple checksum over the consumed integer item.

source_nl: Implement a single-item producer-consumer handoff using a mutex and a condition variable. The producer prepares an integer item, marks the slot ready, and wakes the waiting consumer, which consumes the item and computes a simple checksum before both threads exit. Ensure there is no deadlock or lost wakeup and that any produced item is eventually consumed.
